source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Characteristics of Successful Entrepreneurs (PDF 131, printed 127).

blocks.text: Kamyab entrepreneurs creative hote hain aur masle hal karne ke liye hamesha naye khayalat dhoondte rehte hain. Woh mehnati hote hain aur apne maqsad hasil karne ke liye pakke rehte hain. Achhe entrepreneurs pur-aitmad hote hain aur soch samajh kar (calculated) risk lene ko tayyar hote hain. Un mein faisla karne aur masle hal karne ki mazboot salahiyat hoti hai. Woh lachakdar (adaptable) bhi hote hain aur market ke badalte halaat aur customers ki zarooraton ke mutabiq dhal jate hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Calculated risk ka matlab hai soch samajh kar liya gaya khatra: pehle faide aur nuqsan ka andaza, phir faisla. Yeh juwa (andha khatra) nahi.

blocks.prompt: Kamyab entrepreneur ki paanch khoobiyan likhein.
blocks.explanation: Creative (naye ideas), hardworking aur committed, confident aur calculated risks lene wala, achhe faisle aur masle hal karne ki salahiyat, aur adaptable (badalti market ke mutabiq dhal jane wala).

items: Khoobiyan: creativity, mehnat, confidence, calculated risk, decision-making, adaptability.
